mapper.select: SELECT * FROM project WHERE project_id = #{id} AND is_delete = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS projectCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.project_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(c.contract_amount), 0) AS contractAmount, COALESCE(SUM(c.base_amount), 0) AS baseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(c.benefit_amount), 0) AS benefitAmount FROM project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(contract_amount) AS contract_amount, SUM(base_amount) AS base_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN contract_type = 1 THEN benefit_amount ELSE 0 END) AS benefit_amount FROM contract WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) c ON c.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.parent_project_id = #{parentId} AND p.is_delete = 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_delete = 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.project_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.project_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingAcceptanceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.project_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.contract_amount), 0) as totalContractAmount FROM project p LEFT JOIN contract c ON c.project_id = p.project_id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE p.is_delete = 0 AND (p.archive_status IS NULL OR p.archive_status != 1)
